response.justification: Bogdan is a broadly experienced, senior full-stack engineer with real geospatial (GIS) domain exposure through GISCollective, but his day-to-day technical stack is overwhelmingly TypeScript/Node.js/JavaScript with D as his most 'systems-level' language. Modern C++ or Rust experience is not demonstrated in his employment history (his only C/C++ work was in 2014-2015 on an IDE), and there's no evidence of distributed-systems routing pipelines, tiling, or navigation-grade production work, making him a weak match for a C++/Rust-focused routing tiling role.
strengths: Genuine geospatial/GIS domain experience via GISCollective and Green Map projects
Senior-level, versatile engineer comfortable across many stacks and full-stack roles
Some low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (Dunnhumby, async I/O, fibers, high-performance DBs)
concerns: No recent or substantial modern C++ or Rust experience — primary language requirement not met
No demonstrated experience with routing/navigation pipelines, traffic data integration, or map tiling at scale
Career trajectory has moved toward web/product/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than deep systems/C++ engineering
